name: teleport-monorepo
description: teleport: Chrome DevTools and measured trials for web apps on devices and other Chromium you can't attach to. Development monorepo; the published package is packages/tlpt.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-protocol.mjs && tsc -b packages/protocol packages/stats packages/server && npm run build -w @tlpt/agent -w @teleport/inspector && npm run build -w tlpt
scripts.dev: npm run build && node packages/server/bin/teleport.js examples/hello-device
scripts.check: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/stats packages/server && tsc -p packages/agent && eslint packages/agent/src packages/inspector/src && node scripts/check-agent.mjs && node packages/agent/test-es5/run.js
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run check && npm pack -w tlpt
